title: KRSA: Kinome Random Sampling Analyzer
text: Kinome Random Sampling Analyzer, KRSA, R Shiny application automates many steps required analyze PamChip datasets, including peptide filtering, random sampling, heatmap generation, kinase network generation. new software makes analyzing kinome array datasets accessible eliminates much human workload previous method required. importantly, KRSA represents results bigger biological context visualizing altered kinome signaling networks instead individual kinases. info PamStation12 platform can found : PamGene
